title: Reject secure request payload length overflow before OSCORE reservation
description: Robustness review of SecureStack::send_secure_request found the new protected length expression 1 + class_e_len + payload.len() + TAG_LEN can overflow usize for an adversarially large caller slice before bounded frame preflight. Compute the length with checked arithmetic and return CoapEncode before reserving sender state; add a regression test if practical.
